As Apple (AAPL) Stock Rose, Wilbanks Smith & Thomas Asset Management Has Lowered Position; As Sysco (SYY) Share Value Rose, Transamerica Financial Advisors Upped Its Position by $945,416
June 7, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Wilbanks Smith & Thomas Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3.09% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wilbanks Smith & Thomas Asset Management Llc sold 3,634 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 114,149 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $19.15M, down from 117,783 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wilbanks Smith & Thomas Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $953.44B market cap company. The stock increased 0.35% or $0.67 during the last trading session, reaching $193.98. About 17.33 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 7, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Transamerica Financial Advisors Inc increased its stake in Sysco Corp (SYY) by 11.2% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Transamerica Financial Advisors Inc bought 16,024 shares as the company’s stock rose 7.86% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 159,065 shares of the food distributors company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $9.54M, up from 143,041 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Transamerica Financial Advisors Inc who had been investing in Sysco Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $34.27 billion market cap company.
